changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwadditionalmeasurements AS SELECT am.id, am.patient_id, am.encounter_id, am.age_group, am.hearing_test, am.dehydration, am.nasal_flaring, am.response_to_light, am.pupil_response, am.ability_to_follow_target, am.color_testing, am.fall_risk, am.vision_problems_affecting_function, am.hearing_problems_affecting_function, am.details, am.action_to_take, am.is_active, am.created_by, am.created_date, am.last_modified_by, am.last_modified_date FROM public.additional_measurements am;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwadditionalmeasurements TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwadditionalmeasurements FROM report_user;
